title: Identification of L-functions in the extended Selberg class by preimages of finite sets
summary: In 2023, Li, Du, Yi proved a uniqueness theorem for L functions in the extended Selberg class under the assumptions of positive degree, a shared functional equation, and the sharing of three complex values. This was later strengthened by the present authors, who showed that sharing an arbitrary finite set of complex values, counted with multiplicities, still forces equality of the two L functions, again under the assumption that they satisfy the same functional equation.
